verses.text: A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.
lines: A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness,
and defies all sound judgment.

verses.text: A fool has no delight in understanding, but only in revealing his own opinion.
lines: A fool has no delight in understanding,
but only in revealing his own opinion.

verses.text: When wickedness comes, contempt also comes, and with shame comes disgrace.
lines: When wickedness comes, contempt also comes,
and with shame comes disgrace.

verses.text: The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.
lines: The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters.
The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.

verses.text: To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good, nor to deprive the innocent of justice.
lines: To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good,
nor to deprive the innocent of justice.

verses.text: A fool’s lips come into strife, and his mouth invites beatings.
lines: A fool’s lips come into strife,
and his mouth invites beatings.

verses.text: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are a snare to his soul.
lines: A fool’s mouth is his destruction,
and his lips are a snare to his soul.

verses.text: The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels: they go down into a person’s innermost parts.
lines: The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels:
they go down into a person’s innermost parts.

verses.text: One who is slack in his work is brother to him who is a master of destruction.
lines: One who is slack in his work
is brother to him who is a master of destruction.

verses.text: Yahweh’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.
lines: Yahweh’s name is a strong tower:
the righteous run to him, and are safe.

verses.text: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.
lines: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city,
like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.

verses.text: Before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility.
lines: Before destruction the heart of man is proud,
but before honor is humility.

verses.text: He who answers before he hears, that is folly and shame to him.
lines: He who answers before he hears,
that is folly and shame to him.

verses.text: A man’s spirit will sustain him in sickness, but a crushed spirit, who can bear?
lines: A man’s spirit will sustain him in sickness,
but a crushed spirit, who can bear?

verses.text: The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.
lines: The heart of the discerning gets knowledge.
The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.

verses.text: A man’s gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men.
lines: A man’s gift makes room for him,
and brings him before great men.

verses.text: He who pleads his cause first seems right; until another comes and questions him.
lines: He who pleads his cause first seems right;
until another comes and questions him.

verses.text: The lot settles disputes, and keeps strong ones apart.
lines: The lot settles disputes,
and keeps strong ones apart.

verses.text: A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city. Disputes are like the bars of a fortress.
lines: A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city.
Disputes are like the bars of a fortress.

verses.text: A man’s stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth. With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied.
lines: A man’s stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth.
With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied.

verses.text: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.
lines: Death and life are in the power of the tongue;
those who love it will eat its fruit.

verses.text: Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor of Yahweh.
lines: Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing,
and obtains favor of Yahweh.

verses.text: The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.
lines: The poor plead for mercy,
but the rich answer harshly.

verses.text: A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
lines: A man of many companions may be ruined,
but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
